name: highwater-too
description: Write screenplays and manuscripts in .highland files, with preview and PDF export, plus a git writing history.

scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('../../LICENSE','LICENSE')" && vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../../highwater-too.vsix

commands.title: Link Writing History to This File
Turn Writing History Off or On for This Document
Open .md Files as Ordinary Markdown Again
Check Spelling While Typing (On or Off)

highwater.historyFolder.markdownDescription: Folder for the writing history (one git repository, a branch per document) and session backups. Empty: the system's place for application data (on a Mac, `~/Library/Application Support/Highwater Too/History`; on Linux, `~/.local/share/highwater-too/history`; on Windows, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Highwater Too\History`). Use the **Change Writing History Location** command to move it.

highwater.highlandShortcuts.markdownDescription: Writing shortcuts in documents: ⌘E for Preview, ⌘0 for the sidebar, ⌘1 to ⌘5 for its panels and ⇧⌘I for Show Invisibles, instead of VS Code's meanings for those keys. With it off, Preview is ⌃⌥P.

enumDescriptions: On every computer; double-spaced, so pages hold a line or two more than in the PDF.
The PDF's font, embedded in the file so Word and LibreOffice show it without installing it (Pages and Google Docs do not).

highwater.writingHistory.markdownDescription: Record each save in the writing history (a git repository in the history folder, one branch per document). Needs git (on a Mac, the Xcode command-line tools).

highwater.historyRemote.markdownDescription: Mirror the writing history to this git remote: one repository holding every work, pushed to after saves and never force-pushed. Any host: for example `https://github.com/you/writing-history.git`, `git@gitlab.com:you/history.git` or `ssh://you@server/srv/git/history.git`. Empty: no mirror. Use **Set Up History Mirror…** to set it and create the repository.

highwater.historyMatchMinWords.markdownDescription: A file this computer has no writing history for is recognised as a work in the history when its text is exactly one of that work's saves, but only if it has at least this many words, so empty files and templates never match. (It is always asked before anything is fetched.)

highwater.theme.markdownDescription: Colours for the Highwater Editor and its sidebar: `vscode` (VS Code's own colours), one of the built-in themes, or a custom theme (`custom:<id>`). Easiest to choose with the theme button at the top right of the Highwater Editor, or **Choose Theme…**.

highwater.customThemes.markdownDescription: Your own themes, made or imported with **Manage Themes…** in the Highwater Editor's theme menu: ten theme colours, a name, and light or dark.

highwater.fontSize.markdownDescription: Text size in the Highwater Editor, in pixels. **0** follows VS Code's editor font size, scaled up about 1.4 times. ⌘+ and ⌘− change it; ⌥⌘0 sets it back to 0.

highwater.themeWindow.markdownDescription: When a theme is chosen, colour the whole VS Code window to match (VS Code's colour theme becomes **Highwater** + the theme's name, or **Highwater Custom Light** / **Dark** for your own themes). Choosing VS Code's colours puts back the colour theme you had before.

highwater.darkPages.markdownDescription: With a dark theme, show the printed pages dark too: the page in the theme's sidebar colour and the print in its sidebar text colour. Saved and exported PDFs are unchanged. Also in **Manage Themes…**.

highwater.paragraphNumbers.markdownDescription: Show paragraph numbers in the Highwater Editor's margin: every line with text is numbered, except the title page, notes and omitted text on lines of their own, and directives such as `{{HEADER}}` and markers. **Go to Paragraph…** (⌃G) goes to a number.

highwater.pageBreaks.markdownDescription: Show where each printed page starts in the Highwater Editor's text: a short line in the right margin with the page number. Updated a second after typing stops.

highwater.spellCheck.markdownDescription: Check spelling as you type in the Highwater Editor, in American English: misspelled words get red dots under them. Right-click one for guesses, **Ignore Spelling** or **Learn Spelling**; ⌘; goes to the next misspelling. Character names (from cues), scene-heading prefixes, directives, addresses and omitted text aren't checked.

highwater.spellingWords.markdownDescription: Words **Learn Spelling** has added to the Highwater Editor's dictionary (any document). Add or remove words here too.

highwater.templates.screenplay.body.markdownDescription: The Screenplay template's Body font (Template Options): all its text. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.multiCam.body.markdownDescription: The Multi-Cam template's Body font (Template Options): all its text. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.multiCam.uppercaseAc.markdownDescription: Multi-Cam prints action, lyrics and centred text in capitals (the Uppercase action option).

highwater.templates.stagePlay.body.markdownDescription: The Stage Play template's Body font (Template Options): all its text. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.graphicNovel.body.markdownDescription: The Graphic Novel template's Body font (Template Options): all its text. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.manuscript.body.markdownDescription: The Manuscript template's Body font (Template Options): all its text. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.manuscript.indentLea.markdownDescription: Manuscript indents every paragraph, the first after a heading or scene break too (the Indent leading paragraphs option).

highwater.templates.manuscript.spaceBefo.markdownDescription: Manuscript starts a heading that opens a page (the first, or one after `===`) a third of the way down it (the Add space before section headers option).

highwater.templates.novel.headers.markdownDescription: The Novel template's Headers font (Template Options): its headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.novel.body.markdownDescription: The Novel template's Body font (Template Options): everything but the headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.treatment.body.markdownDescription: The Treatment template's Body font (Template Options): all its text. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.modernStandard.heade.markdownDescription: The Modern Standard template's Headers font (Template Options): its headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.modernStandard.body.markdownDescription: The Modern Standard template's Body font (Template Options): everything but the headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.article.headers.markdownDescription: The Article template's Headers font (Template Options): its headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.article.body.markdownDescription: The Article template's Body font (Template Options): everything but the headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.bulletin.body.markdownDescription: The Bulletin template's Body font (Template Options): all its text. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.speech.headers.markdownDescription: The Speech template's Headers font (Template Options): its headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.speech.body.markdownDescription: The Speech template's Body font (Template Options): everything but the headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.wiki.headers.markdownDescription: The Wiki template's Headers font (Template Options): its headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.templates.wiki.body.markdownDescription: The Wiki template's Body font (Template Options): everything but the headings. Choose it in the Highwater Editor's template window too. Fonts that aren't installed print in a bundled stand-in.

highwater.editorFont.markdownDescription: The Highwater Editor's font. Both have the same character width, so the editor's lines still match the printed pages. Also in **Settings…** (General).

enumDescriptions: The printed page's width: lines break where they print.
Wider than the page; lines no longer break where they print.
highwater.columnWidth.markdownDescription: How wide the Highwater Editor's text column is. Also in **Settings…** (General).

highwater.lineSpacing.markdownDescription: The space between lines in the Highwater Editor. Also in **Settings…** (General).

highwater.invisiblesBrightness.markdownDescription: How bright **Show Invisibles**' marks are, from 0 (faint) to 100. Also in **Settings…** (General).

highwater.saveCursorPosition.markdownDescription: Reopening a document in the Highwater Editor puts the cursor back where it was. Also in **Settings…** (General).

highwater.sidebarText.markdownDescription: The size of the Highwater Editor's sidebar text. Also in **Settings…** (General).

highwater.navigatorMarkup.markdownDescription: The Navigator shows sections, synopses and notes as written: `# Act One`, `= synopsis`, `[[note]]`. Also in **Settings…** (General).

highwater.excludeNotesFromWordCount.markdownDescription: Leave the words in notes out of the document's word count. Also in **Settings…** (General).
